items.requirement: The video covers one coherent task or topic and uses a source-verified script or outline.
The demonstrated environment and interface are current, permitted, and training-safe.
The complete final file was played and checked for audio, timing, synchronization, legibility, crop, and export defects.
On-screen text, callouts, terminology, and visual style follow the approved profile.
Captions were reviewed for accuracy after final upload or packaging.
A transcript and descriptions or equivalent access are provided when required; visual-only actions are explained.
Rights, permissions, privacy, metadata, thumbnail, destination, owner, support, and review trigger are verified.
